method: MIX WATER, FLOUR, YEAST, SUGAR AND SALT. ADD SLOWLY THE OIL AND EGGS
LET THE DOUGH RISE FOR A NIGHT IN THE FRIDGE.
DIVIDE IN 80g PORTIONS ET PLACE THEM IN MOULDS. LET THEM RISE FOR 2 HOURS.
BRUSH THE EGG YOLKS ON THE SMALL PORTIONS AND ADD THE SEEDS.
COOK 9 MINUTES AT 180° IN THE OVEN.
title: LA CHALLAH SHABOUR
